title: panicum lanatum
intro: Panicum lanatum, commonly known as switchgrass, is a type of perennial grass native to North America. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and relieving digestive issues due to its anti-inflammatory and carminative properties. The therapeutic actions of Panicum lanatum include its ability to act as a diuretic, soothing skin irritations, and supporting the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
